name: CBO Two-Campaign (fixed control)
description: Control for cbo-two-campaign: both campaigns strategy=fixed at an equal split (10 + 10), nothing moves budget. One advertiser, account budget 20, two campaigns with identical CPM and targeting but a 3x tap-through gap (30% vs 10% of clicks). 3 simulated days of 300s (day 1 is warm-up). Compare account tap-throughs per unit of spend and the per-campaign budget trace against the -fixed control. Gate for #38.
